about.diet: Barnacles, oysters, crabs, and fiddler crabs
about.behavior: Uses human teeth to scrape barnacles and oysters off bridge pilings, seawalls, docks, and rock jetties. Spawns in late winter near inlets.
about.timing_note: Patterns reported by local captains and fishing writers, not tested by studies.
